messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep using this medication"
set: ["if you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep using this medication", "keep taking even when feeling fine if being treated for high blood pressure", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure", "condition being treated", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well", "keep using the medication as directed", "keep using even if you feel well", "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication", "keep using carvedilol even if you feel well", "dose depends on condition being treated", "do this even if you are feeling well", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine", "follow diet, medication, and exercise routines very closely if being treated for hypertension", "keep using as directed", "ask your doctor if you can keep using this medicine after 6 months of daily use"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "keep taking even when feeling fine if being treated for high blood pressure",
    "keep using this medicine even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure",
    "keep using even if you feel well if you have high blood pressure",
    "keep using this medicine even if you feel well",
    "keep using even if you feel well",
    "keep using as directed",
    "keep using the medication as directed",
    "follow diet, medication, and exercise routines very closely if being treated for hypertension"
  ],
  "alias": "keep using this medication even if you feel well"
}
